a1_single_winner_absent_on_tie.description: Ordinary single-winner assembly at x (1-1 leaf-outgroup ties on R1-R4 and L2 committed as null at 0.50); r uses active-child parsimony.

a2_single_winner_over_retain.description: Ordinary single-winner assembly where x over-retains -k on all <a k : b Ø> columns (including A1-A4); r discounts <x k : y Ø> -> null while retaining <x k : y g> -> *k.

b1_privileged_oracle_x_full.description: Option 1 operator control: x replaced by generator-truth forms + source FormAnalysis (cog:two_level_propagation_v1:c001..c012).

b2_privileged_oracle_x_segments_only.description: Option 1 operator control: x replaced by generator-truth segment strings with whole:unknown analysis (no cognate_set_id).

c1_tied_beam_retention.description: Option 2a: exact same x and y commitments as a1, with tied_confidence_threshold=0.5 retaining competing proto-segments on <=0.50 commitments.

c2_leaf_witness_at_r.description: Option 2b: single-winner assembly a1 at x and y, with r querying raw leaf witnesses (search_forms) and committing non-invertible <x Ø : y g> -> *k.

l2_root_restoration_check.error_message: 1 restoration(s) were requested at a node with no out-group, so nothing can license one

d1_tree_rotation_y_before_x.description: Option 3 tree rotation ((c,d)y,(a,b)x)r;: y reconstructs first and becomes a visible reconstructed outgroup for x.

operational_weight_sensitivity.description: When unanimous identity columns carry confidence < 1.0 (e.g. 0.95), a 3-column tuple (k o t, k o t) pays an extra log(0.95) length penalty relative to a 2-column tuple (k o, k o); at identity_confidence=1.0 both candidates tie at exact 0.5 / 0.5.
